episodeTitle: India's fertility has fallen below replacement

prompt.en: What was India's total fertility rate (children per woman) in NFHS-5, 2019–21?
prompt.hi: NFHS-5 (2019–21) में भारत की कुल प्रजनन दर (प्रति महिला बच्चे) कितनी थी?

explain.en: 2.0, down from 2.2 in NFHS-4 (2015–16). Replacement level is about 2.1, so India as a whole is now just below it, though states differ widely.
explain.hi: 2.0, NFHS-4 (2015–16) के 2.2 से कम। प्रतिस्थापन स्तर लगभग 2.1 है, इसलिए पूरा भारत अब इससे थोड़ा नीचे है, हालाँकि राज्यों में बड़ा अंतर है।

takeaway.en: Fewer births now means more working-age adults for a few decades: the demographic dividend, if there are jobs.
takeaway.hi: अब कम जन्म का मतलब है कुछ दशकों तक ज़्यादा कामकाजी उम्र के लोग: जनसांख्यिकीय लाभांश, अगर रोज़गार हो।

sources: National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5), 2019–21, India Fact Sheet (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare; rchiips.org/nfhs)

review.note: Written by Claude from the listed sources, 14 Nov 2026. Hindi by Claude. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor.
